text:
Maya: Short thread — ops wants to unpin runtime 2.18 for quant-v5 in eu-west during tonight's 02:00 UTC change window. Root cause: beam-search perf regression fix. Need signoff + rollback plan.

Jonah: what's the telemetry look like? any recent regressions on longseq or embeddings? :eyes: 

Maya: perf fix landed in runtime at 09:40 PT; staging runs show ~8-12% token latency drop, no regression on 4k seq tests. Telemetry: canary showed slight increase in memory in a small subset of pods. Quick numbers below.

Maya: `staging-canary: p90=190ms -> 175ms; p99=420ms -> 390ms; mem +2% peak`

Sasha: prefer rollforward in a small cohort. suggest 10% traffic in eu-west first, observe for 60m for OOM / tail latency. rollback if p99 regresses >5% or errors spike.

Ravi: we need release notes and pinlist updated. confirm SDK shim 3.4 is available as fallback. any model bindings that require older runtime?

Maya: quant-v5 flagged require runtime >=2.16 so okay. SDK calls unaffected. Deploybot, can you run pinlist diff and schedule canary?

deploybot: [deploybot] pinlist-diff: runtime 2.18 -> will be unpinned for quant-v5 in eu-west per request. Canary scheduled 02:05 UTC, cohort=10%, duration=60m. Rollback job created: `rollback-runtime-2.18` (instant restore to pinned state if triggered).

Jonah: :eyes: can we add an alert for p99 >= +5% or error-rate +0.5% relative to baseline? also exclude Dedicated/enterprise traffic from this unpin.

Sasha: yes — will add traffic filter tier!=enterprise and inject alert thresholds. will also keep the dedicated pool pinned.

Ravi: release notes draft: "Runtime: tentative unpin of 2.18 for quant-v5 in eu-west to pick latest runtime build with beam-search perf improvements. Canary 10% eu-west. Excluded: Dedicated/Enterprise. Rollback criteria: p99 +5% or error-rate +0.5%." i'll push to docs repo after review.

Maya: ack. nightshift owners please keep watch 02:05–04:00 UTC. if no alerts we proceed to full unpin at 04:30 UTC. if anomaly -> immediate rollback.

Jonah: :thumbsup: i'll be on-call and will escalate to runtime eng if needed.

Sasha: :rotating_light: canary playbook: https://go/release/canary-playbook. quick rollback command for ops: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=stable`

Maya: approved. :white_check_mark: 

Ravi: leaving a note for postmortem template in case we need it: "time, cohort, metric deltas, root cause, mitigation steps, followups"

deploybot: [deploybot] canary started 02:05 UTC; cohort 10%; monitoring hooks active.

Maya: thanks everyone, will update the pinned list and release notes once canary passes.
